ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows: in culture A there is only P. caudatum, and its population density rises with the number of days and then tends to stabilize at a relatively high level; in culture B there is only P. bursaria, and its population density also rises and then tends to stabilize at a relatively low level; culture C is a mixed culture of the two populations, and the two growth curves in the graph do not drop to zero, but instead each grows and reaches a stable plateau, indicating that the two can coexist for a long time.
